title: Open a table — lake_open
code: # A one-file table written by hand, so the example needs nothing else. path <- tempfile("table") dir.create(file.path(path, "_delta_log"), recursive = TRUE) writeLines(c(   '{"protocol":{"minReaderVersion":1,"minWriterVersion":2}}',   paste0(     '{"metaData":{"id":"example","format":{"provider":"parquet","options":{}},',     '"schemaString":"{\\"type\\":\\"struct\\",\\"fields\\":[{\\"name\\":',     '\\"id\\",\\"type\\":\\"long\\",\\"nullable\\":true,\\"metadata\\":{}}]}",',     '"partitionColumns":[],"configuration":{}}}'   ),   paste0(     '{"add":{"path":"part-0.parquet","partitionValues":{},"size":100,',     '"modificationTime":0,"dataChange":true}}'   ) ), file.path(path, "_delta_log", "00000000000000000000.json"))  lake_is_table(path) #> [1] TRUE tbl <- lake_open(path) lake_version(tbl) #> [1] 0 tbl0 <- lake_load(tbl, version = 0)  unlink(path, recursive = TRUE)
